description:
A free PDF editor for Windows with true redaction that removes the pixels, plus page editing, drawing measurement, watermarks, page numbers, passwords and compression.

PDF MARIN is a free desktop PDF editor for Windows. It redacts text and images by
removing the underlying content rather than drawing a black box over it, and it can
extract, reorder, rotate and merge pages, measure dimensions on drawings with a
calibrated scale, add watermarks and page numbers, set or remove passwords, and
compress files. The user interface is in Japanese.
PDF MARIN v0.4.2
内蔵の外部生成AI連携を撤去しました。ローカルOCR・翻訳と汎用MCP接続は引き続き利用できます。本文編集の道具箱の配置と追加設定の開閉を修正し、段落編集を開けない場合の案内を改善しました。PDF読込時のタブ切替や一部のファイル情報取得失敗への対処、開けなかった場合の通知を改善しました。印刷画面では2つの印刷方法と、利用できない場合の理由を分かりやすくしました。
Removed the built-in external generative AI integration. Local OCR, local translation, and general-purpose MCP connections remain available. Fixed the text-editing toolbar layout and additional-options toggle, and improved messages when paragraph editing is unavailable. Improved handling of tab changes and some file-information failures during PDF loading, including failure notifications. Clarified the two print options and why an option is unavailable.
